advancement.guide.ch1.start.title: Welcome to Alan's Modpack
advancement.guide.ch1.start.desc: This book guides you through the modpack. Start by mining.
advancement.guide.ch1.iron_pickaxe.title: First Iron Pickaxe
advancement.guide.ch1.deep.title: Into the Deep
advancement.guide.ch1.eight_ores.title: All Eight Ores
advancement.guide.ch1.eight_ores.desc: Collect coal, copper, iron, gold, redstone, lapis, diamond and emerald. They are what a mine world is made of.
advancement.guide.ch2.backpack.title: Alchemy Backpack
advancement.guide.ch2.backpack.desc: Craft the alchemy backpack. Items put into it become energy.
advancement.guide.ch2.first_deposit.desc: Put an item into the backpack to turn it into energy.
advancement.guide.ch2.scholar.title: Scholar
advancement.guide.ch2.scholar.desc: Let the backpack learn 20 different items.
advancement.guide.ch2.redeem.title: Redeem
advancement.guide.ch2.redeem.desc: Take an item out of the backpack with its energy.
advancement.guide.ch3.cauldron.title: World Cauldron
advancement.guide.ch3.cauldron.desc: Throw one of each of the eight ores into a water cauldron to make a world cauldron.
advancement.guide.ch3.enter.title: Into the Mine World
advancement.guide.ch3.enter.desc: Stand on a world cauldron and sneak to enter your mine world.
advancement.guide.ch3.harvest.title: Bumper Harvest
advancement.guide.ch3.harvest.desc: Hold 16 diamonds, 16 emeralds and 64 redstone at once.
advancement.guide.ch3.second_world.title: A Second World
advancement.guide.ch3.second_world.desc: Make a second world cauldron. Every one is a different world.
advancement.guide.ch4.controller.title: The Heart of the Warehouse
advancement.guide.ch4.controller.desc: Place a warehouse controller. A network has exactly one.
advancement.guide.ch4.terminal.title: See the Warehouse
advancement.guide.ch4.terminal.desc: Place a terminal and connect it to the controller with cable.
advancement.guide.ch4.cell.title: First Storage Cell
advancement.guide.ch4.cell.desc: Get a storage cell. It holds the warehouse's virtual stock.
advancement.guide.ch4.interfaces.title: In and Out
advancement.guide.ch4.interfaces.desc: Place an input and an output interface to move items in and out automatically.
advancement.guide.ch4.automation.title: Automation
advancement.guide.ch4.automation.desc: Place a crafting terminal and an auto crafter.
advancement.guide.ch4.power_and_teleport: Place a generator and a teleporter.
advancement.guide.ch5.first_form.title: First Form
advancement.guide.ch5.first_form.desc: Kill a mob to unlock its form.
advancement.guide.ch5.first_transform.de: Press V to open the form menu and become a mob.
advancement.guide.ch5.first_skill.title: Skill
advancement.guide.ch5.first_skill.desc: Become a form with a skill and press R to use it.
advancement.guide.ch5.ten_forms.title: Collector
advancement.guide.ch5.thirty_forms.title: Museum
advancement.guide.ch5.all_forms.title: Every Form
advancement.guide.ch6.trinket.title: First Trinket
advancement.guide.ch6.trinket.desc: Get any trinket and press K to wear it.
advancement.guide.ch6.armor_upgrade.desc: Strengthen a piece of armor with an ore at an anvil.
advancement.guide.ch6.bow_upgrade.title: Bowyer's Craft
advancement.guide.ch6.bow_upgrade.desc: Upgrade a bow at an anvil.
advancement.guide.ch6.vanilla_bosses.des: Defeat the Wither and the Ender Dragon. The form altar asks for a nether star and a dragon's breath.
advancement.guide.ch6.form_king.title: The Form King
advancement.guide.ch6.form_king.desc: Collect every form and defeat the Form King at the form altar.
advancement.guide.ch6.master_charm.title: Master's Charm
advancement.guide.ch6.master_charm.desc: Craft the master's charm from a form core.
